observations.statement: The opening is a collage of several post-like screens laid over the presenter and whiteboard. Readable figures include 10万+, 3.7万, 3080, 832.7万, 976.0万浏览, 2903.0万浏览, 101.8万 and 1358.0万浏览, but the sampled pixels do not establish a shared account, platform, date, or ownership of those figures.
The burned-in title visible in the opening montage reads 开头展示教资; the supplied SRT instead contains 开头展示饺子 in CUE-001.

The same masked presenter, whiteboard, marker, lavalier microphone and room remain the dominant visual setting. The continuity supports a classroom-style presenter role; it does not identify the person behind the mask or establish any external credential.
The board title reads 底层逻辑 and 百万爆款是怎样炼成的：实操落地. The left branch is headed 必要条件 and the right branch 实操落地.

The necessary-condition branch visually lists four numbered points: understandability/low comprehension cost, a large linked group, satisfying why users open the platform through emotion or information, and interaction. Interaction is diagrammed as comment through empathy or rebuttal, or forwarding/@ing a friend through sharing and spread.
Under 类型 the board separates 万古同悲/极致共情, 惊世骇俗/硬素材, and 打破节奏. The third branch includes the visible shorthand 10s以内的可爱动物; the exact mechanism is supplied by speech rather than demonstrated footage.
The board places the example name 王虹 beside a combination of the first two mechanisms. The burned subtitle at about 112 seconds also reads 王虹, while the supplied SRT uses 王宏 in CUE-039.

The right-side 找选题 branch divides into 看自己 and 看世界. The self-side asks about rare accomplishments or capabilities, unusually large strengths or weaknesses, and an extreme skill; the world-side lists finding anger, sorrow and contradiction. Some handwritten shorthand is occluded, so the spoken wording controls where the board is incomplete.
The 选形式 branch visibly separates 共情 from 特长/特点. The empathy side lists 图片+BGM, 氛围短视频+BGM and 文案+BGM; the feature side lists 完整叙事, 中长视频 and 把事说明白.

A horizontal boundary and question mark separate the ordinary two-step branches above from a lower shortcut: 立刻结合热点去表达. The separation supports treating the hotspot method as an exception/shortcut rather than a third child inside either ordinary branch.

The burned closing subtitle reads 我是人类最强编导, while CUE-068 in the supplied SRT reads 我是人类最善变的. The phrase functions visually as a closing self-description/tagline, not independently verified identity or credential.

Across the complete dense and targeted visual scan, no actual cat clip, post analytics page with attributable account/date, Fields-award source, end-to-end production demonstration, publishing interface, platform/account prerequisite screen, music-rights guidance, or visible follow/purchase/download CTA card was observed. The video does contain a spoken next-episode farewell.

limitations: Handwriting is partly occluded by the presenter and remains ambiguous in several places even after high-resolution resampling.
Visual absence claims are bounded to the 0–213.809 second source video and the documented full-scope sampling protocol.
No external identity, award, metric, account, platform or causal claim is inferred from visual resemblance or juxtaposition.
